title: Limits and colimits of abelian presheaves exist and are computed sectionwise

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that all limits and colimits exist in the category of abelian presheaves on a category and are computed by taking limits and colimits of the groups of sections over each object. The proof defines the candidate presheaves L and C sectionwise by the limits and colimits in abelian groups, exhibits the comparison maps by using the corresponding maps on sections, and verifies the universal properties objectwise, which is exactly the content of the sectionwise statement (proof lines 299-315). H2: the objectwise construction and the verification of the universal property are the substance, and the argument is short but complete.
